messages.subject: Planned DMS maintenance - Saturday 13 September
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The document management system (iManage) will be unavailable on Saturday 13 September between 07:00 and 11:00 BST for scheduled maintenance and indexing. Please check in any documents you are working on before close of play on Friday. Email and the network will be unaffected.

If you have an urgent need to access documents during the window, contact the helpdesk on x2200.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
